label: order compliance fulfillment process: Review safety and incident history — Analyze supplier and fulfillment partner safety performance and incident records to mitigate delivery risk.

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

CORP.ITSM SYSTEM - IT SERVICE MANAGEMENT:
Agent: corp.itsm:agent:ChangeReleaseCoordinator:v1 ✓ BEST for integrated service change mgmt with incident response & stakeholder notification
Agent: corp.itsm:agent:IncidentSafetyCoordinator:v1 - coordinates incident response, escalates to teams, processes compliance notifications
Agent: corp.itsm:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1 - analyzes service tickets, correlates incidents with change requests
Agent: corp.itsm:agent:ChangeAutomationOrchestrator:v1 - automates engineering change approvals, material updates, product deployments
Agent: corp.itsm:agent:AssetProvisioningOrchestrator:v1 - coordinates provisioning with change schedules, fulfillment notifications

SUPPLIER SAFETY & INCIDENT TRACKING:
Agent: sap.ariba:agent:SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor:v1 ✓ BEST for supplier safety/incident analysis - tracks hazardous materials, ingests real-time safety events, identifies non-compliance, routes alerts for risk mitigation
  - Related entities: HazardousSubstance, Incident, SafetyIncident
  - Tags: hazardous-materials, vendor-risk-management, safety-event-tracking

SAP.S4 AGENTS:
Agent: sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent:v1 - validates BOM against supplier qualifications & regulatory requirements
Agent: sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent:v1 - matches requisitions to vendors on cost/quality/delivery performance
Agent: sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine:v1 - order creation, account eligibility, credit & inventory validation

SAP.ARIBA AGENTS:
Agent: sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1 - 3-way matching, discrepancy flags
Agent: sap.ariba:agent:MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator:v1 - coordinates material updates & engineering changes through procurement

CHANGE MGMT & QA:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:QualityAssuranceAndDefectPrevention:v1 - QA/defect prevention, monitors machines, automates quality inspection
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1 - engineering changes, BOM updates, supply chain impact

PURCHASE ORDER & PROCUREMENT:
API: sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1
Agent: sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent:v1

CAMPAIGN PERFORMANCE & MARKETING:
Agent: sap.crm:agent:CampaignAudienceOptimizationCoordinator:v1
Agent: emarsys.cx:agent:SegmentDrivenCampaignOptimizer:v1
